title: Bake-off (hos): z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
question: Who holds power in NEAR’s House of Stake? Make me a fresh flower, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

turns.content: Fresh snapshot pulled — not reused. Now let me read its shape and count the power.
Power counted. Now I'll propose the spec — minimal changes: colour by named-vs-anonymous identity, since almost every account's "kind" is unknown here.

conflicts: House of Stake power can be held as locked NEAR (which earns veNEAR that grows with lock time) or as delegated voting power; this flower draws net voting power (veNEAR) only, not locked amounts.
inferred: The two largest petals being implicit accounts suggests they may be lockup or intermediary contracts whose beneficial owners are the real power holders.

mappings.why: Band width is the account's share of total veNEAR voting power, log-compressed (max_ratio 2) so mid-size delegates stay legible; source venear-accounts counts the balances, hos-source defines the rule.
Bar height is the square root of the share, so 50% of power gives ~0.71 of full height; sqrt is the default convention for shares.
Named account IDs (self-declared names) get one colour, implicit hex accounts another: the eye splits who has staked their identity from who has not; account-id distinguishes named from implicit.
Solid outline where an identity exists, none where it does not; follows identity status from account-id.
Largest voting power first, clockwise from the top; the default order, matching the 'who holds most' reading.

power_means.claim: Power in the House of Stake is veNEAR voting power: each account's own veNEAR minus outgoing delegations plus incoming delegations, as computed by the contract at block 223163884.
Concentration is high: the top 5 accounts hold 50.7% of veNEAR, a Nakamoto coefficient of 5, with HHI 0.084231 and Gini 0.975909.

interpretation.summary: This flower draws who holds voting power in NEAR's House of Stake at block 223163884 (2026-11-05): veNEAR voting power across the 60 largest of 519 accounts, with the remaining 459 grouped as the tail. Two anonymous hex accounts hold the most — the top account alone holds 15.3% — while named accounts hold the next eight spots. The top five together reach 50.7% of all voting power. Colour separates named accounts from anonymous hex accounts; solid outlines mark the named ones.
unknowns: The owners behind the two largest accounts are unknown: they are implicit hex addresses with no identity, and no fusion markings (common control) are available to link them to anyone.
Lockup contracts, their staking, and who controls them are not covered, so the ultimate backers behind locked NEAR are not drawn.
Per-voter votes on vote.dao proposals are not read, so how this voting power has actually been used is not shown.
Off-chain delegate profiles and delegated-in sources beyond on-chain delegation are not checked.
Identity is self-declared account naming only; verified legal identity of account owners is not checked.

Two anonymous hex accounts lead — the biggest holds 15.3% — then eight named accounts (spareuni818, delegatetoyuen, tony_bc, …). The top 5 hold 50.7%; the other 405 accounts group into one hatched tail petal (<0.1%).

**Mapping**:
- **Width** — share of veNEAR voting power, log-compressed (venear-accounts, hos-source)
- **Height** — sqrt of the share (venear-accounts)
- **Colour** — named vs anonymous account (account-id)
- **Outline** — solid where the name is self-declared (account-id)
- **Order** — largest first, clockwise from the top (venear-accounts)

**Changed from the default**: `colour: identity` (kind was unknown for nearly all accounts).

**What this can't tell you**: who is behind the two big anonymous accounts; lockup contracts and their staking; how this power has actually voted on proposals; verified identity — names are self-declared only.
